observation.command:
cd /workspace/deployment/runtimes/compose/dev && echo "=== compose ps ==="; make ps SCENARIO=data_store_backend 2>&1 | tail -4
echo; echo "=== healthz ==="; curl -sS -m 15 http://localhost:8007/healthz -w "
healthz HTTP %{http_code}
"
echo; echo "=== authenticated data round-trip (fresh topic) ==="
curl -sS -m 15 -u ReceiveDataUser:ChangeMe -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"final":"verification","ts":1}' http://localhost:8007/data/final-check/topic1 -w "
POST HTTP %{http_code}
"
curl -sS -m 15 -u ReceiveDataUser:ChangeMe http://localhost:8007/data/final-check/topic1 -w "
GET HTTP %{http_code}
"
echo; echo "=== swagger docs ==="; curl -sS -m 15 -o /dev/null -w "GET /docs/ HTTP %{http_code}
" http://localhost:8007/docs/
echo; echo "=== container runtime ==="; docker ps --filter "name=data-store-backend-service" --format "{{.Names}}	{{.Status}}	{{.Ports}}"
